text:
zoe.finance: Heads-up: Medivox has flagged INV-2026-1011 claiming platform fee appears twice. They put a payment hold. Can someone pull metering export and confirm whether this is a duplicate platform SKU or support proration issue?

mike.revops: Pulling the export now. Any notes on recent contract changes?

arian.am: They did a private deployment migration two weeks ago and upgraded to Premium support the same day. SEs gave them a 3-day validation window that we agreed to credit. Could be migration created a new PLATFORM-FEE SKU and didn't retire old one.

zoe.finance: Invoice snippet pasted:
```
INV-2026-1011
 - PRIVATE-LICENSE-MDV-01 qty 1 $18,000 annual
 - PLATFORM-MDV-01 qty 1 $18,000 annual
 - SUPPORT-PREM-MDV qty 1 $5,040 annual
 - PLATFORM-MDV-01 qty 1 $18,000 annual (appears dup)
```

paul.billing: Metering export available: /billing/exports/2026-03/medivox_20260320.csv (uploaded by metering-bot 2026-03-20T07:55Z). I pulled it and see two active commits overlapping: C-2025 (2025-06-01 -> 2026-05-31) and C-3030 (2026-03-01 -> 2027-02-28). Overlap window 2026-03-01 -> 2026-03-31 shows both platform_fee prorata lines.

mike.revops: That matches the pattern. I'll open an engineering ticket to add an explicit retire step in migration and a unit test asserting at most one platform_fee SKU active per customer-day.

eng-ticket-bot: [system] ENG-4277 created by mike.revops: "migration leaving legacy platform_fee active during contract wrap - Medivox duplicate charge" https://eng.redwood/ENG-4277

arian.am: Customer expectation: 3-day complimentary validation (2026-03-01 -> 2026-03-03). Procurement is holding payment until corrected. Need credit memo + corrected invoice ASAP.

zoe.finance: Paul, can you calculate prorates and draft credit memo? Include the complimentary days. We'll issue corrected INV-2026-1011A.

paul.billing: Calculations: PLATFORM fee $18,000 annual -> daily = 49.3151. Overlap charged 31 days (2026-03-01 -> 2026-03-31) duplicate portion -> $1,528.77. Complimentary 3-day credit -> $147.95. Support proration: Premium $5,040 annual -> daily $13.8082. We billed full year but support upgrade effective 2026-03-02; credit for extra day(s) = 1 day * $13.81 approx -> $13.81. Total credit = 1,528.77 + 147.95 + 13.81 = $1,690.53. Rounding -> $1,690.53. Draft credit memo CREDIT-2026-0488 and corrected INV-2026-1011A uploaded to /billing/credits and /billing/invoices/drafts.

mike.revops: Patch in review. Will add canary run and a quick query to surface customers with overlapping commits in last 30 days.

arian.am: Sent SE sign-off for the complimentary validation window to billing. Forwarding to customer now.

zoe.finance: Approving credit memo. Paul, please apply credit and push corrected invoice to portal. Also add an account note explaining engineering fix and that we proactively scanned customers with migrations in last 30 days.

paul.billing: Credit applied, INV-2026-1011A pushed to portal at 2026-03-21T15:40Z. Notified account team.

arian.am: Customer replied: "Thanks for resolving quickly. We'll release payment once portal reflects credit." :thumbsup:

zoe.finance: Thanks everyone. Mike, please include a short summary in Friday's finance sync about the migration risk and scan results.

eng-ticket-bot: ENG-4277 status set to "in review" by mike.revops

zoe.finance: Closing thread.
